welcome_page.title: E-scooter – Personal security
welcome_page.description:
Lighting and how secure you feel from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter after dark, does poor street lighting change your route or when you ride?

options.text: No, it makes no difference to me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I ride slower or keep to better-lit roads
I take a much longer, better-lit route
I don't ride after dark because of poor lighting
I don't ride after dark for other reasons

questions.text: During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride an e-scooter?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Blind corners or obstructed views
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Overcrowded or chaotic places
None of these

questions.text: When you ride an e-scooter, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?

options.text: Yes
No

it.#<p>Lighting and how secure you feel fro:
Illuminazione e quanto ti senti al sicuro da criminalità o molestie quando vai in monopattino elettrico.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

it.#When you ride an e-scooter after dark,: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico dopo il buio, la scarsa illuminazione delle strade cambia il tuo percorso o gli orari in cui vai?
it.#No, it makes no difference to me: No, per me non fa differenza
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I ride slower or keep to better-lit roa: Vado più piano o resto sulle strade più illuminate
it.#I take a much longer, better-lit route: Faccio un percorso molto più lungo ma meglio illuminato
it.#I don't ride after dark because of poor: Non vado dopo il buio per la scarsa illuminazione
it.#I don't ride after dark for other reaso: Non vado dopo il buio per altri motivi
it.#During the day, do you ever feel unsafe: Durante il giorno, ti è mai capitato di sentirti in pericolo per criminalità o molestie quando vai in monopattino elettrico? (Le molestie comprendono commenti indesiderati, pedinamenti, contatti fisici o comportamenti intimidatori rivolti a te.)

it.#Places with few people around (isolated: Luoghi con poca gente (zone isolate o deserte)
it.#People behaving aggressively or in an i: Persone che si comportano in modo aggressivo o intimidatorio
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Scarsa manutenzione (es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture rotte)
it.#No surveillance or security measures (e: Mancanza di sorveglianza o di misure di sicurezza (es. niente telecamere, niente personale)

fr.#Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildi: Un mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures dégradées)
fr.#No surveillance or security measures (e: L’absence de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméras, pas de personnel)
fr.#Incidents that happened to me or were r: Des incidents qui me sont arrivés ou qui ont été signalés dans le quartier
